title: diospyros ferrea var. lamponga
intro: Diospyros ferrea var. lamponga, commonly known as the Lamponga or Javan Persimmon, is a species of plant in the family Ebenaceae, native to Indonesia. It is known for its edible fruit, which is rich in nutrients and has been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lamponga include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, improve digestion, and reduce inflammation, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antidiabetic properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include oligostilbenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
